body:
TEAM HUD

Team HUD is a client-side mod for Minecraft that displays real-time team information directly on your screen.
It is designed for competitive events and Pixel-style minigames where quick and clear team status is essential.

FEATURES
- Shows active teams
- Displays players per team
- Real-time updates
- Clean and minimal interface
- Configurable screen position
- Lightweight and performance friendly

ENVIRONMENT
Client-side only (visual mod — does not need to be installed on the server).

REQUIREMENTS
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 17+

PERFECT FOR
- UHC
- Competitive minigames
- Any team-based game mode

SUMMARY
A lightweight client-side HUD that shows real-time team information for competitive team-based gameplay.
